user.title: HAP Bridge
user.description: Creates a HomeKit bridge. Integrations that ship a hap_bridge.py describe their own devices; everything else uses a standard mapping.

abort.already_configured: A bridge already uses this port.

rename.title: Rename an accessory
rename.description: Choose the accessory to rename. HomeKit uses this name when the accessory is first added; the Home app keeps its own name after that, so rename already-added accessories there.

rename_accessory.title: Rename an accessory
rename_accessory.description: Its own name is {default}. Leave this empty to go back to it.

camera_audio.title: Cameras
camera_audio.description:
Cameras with audio send their sound to the Home app along with the video. Only choose cameras whose stream has audio: for one without, the video won't play either. Talking back through the camera isn't supported.

While HomeKit Secure Video is on for a camera, ffmpeg keeps running so recordings start a few seconds before what triggered them. On a slow machine, turn that off for some cameras: their recordings then start a second or two after the trigger.

data.camera_no_prebuffer: Cameras that record without a prebuffer

alarm_codes.title: Alarm codes
alarm_codes.description: These alarm panels need a code to arm or disarm, and the Home app has nowhere to enter one. Set a code here and HAP Bridge sends it for you. Anyone who can control the alarm in your Home app can then arm and disarm it. Leave a code empty to remove it.

data.include_integrations: Only expose devices from these integrations (empty = all)
data.include_domains: Only expose these entity domains (empty = all)

error.invalid_name: Use letters, digits, spaces and ' . , & -, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

abort.not_running: The bridge isn't running, so there are no accessories to rename yet.
abort.no_alarm_codes: None of your alarm panels needs a code.

profile_error.title: {integration}'s HomeKit profile has problems

shim_error.title: HomeKit shim {shim} has problems

start_failed.title: HAP Bridge {name} failed to start

accessory_settings.name: Accessory settings
accessory_settings.description: For an accessory (by its HomeKit serial number), its device's settings (configuration entities) and details (diagnostic entities, firmware, the real serial number), shaped like the Home app's extension settings.

serial.name: Serial number
serial.description: The accessory's serial number in HomeKit (HB-...).

set_accessory_setting.name: Set accessory setting
set_accessory_setting.description: Changes one of the settings Accessory settings lists for an accessory.

serial.name: Serial number
serial.description: The accessory's serial number in HomeKit (HB-...).

entity_id.name: Setting
entity_id.description: The setting's entity, from Accessory settings.

value.name: Value
value.description: The new value: on/off, an option, a number or text. Not needed for actions (buttons).

room_assignments.name: Room assignments
room_assignments.description: Lists each accessory HomeKit gets, by serial number, with the Home Assistant area it belongs in. scripts/assign_rooms.py uses this with HomeClaw to put accessories in the matching Home app rooms.

list_pairings.name: List pairings
list_pairings.description: Shows the controllers paired with each part of a bridge (the bridge itself, and each TV and camera): one per Apple ID or home hub key, and which are admins.

remove_pairing.name: Remove pairing
remove_pairing.description: Forgets one paired controller, e.g. a phone you no longer have. Use List pairings to find its ID. When the last one is removed, the pairing code is shown again.

pairing_id.name: Pairing ID
pairing_id.description: The controller's ID, from List pairings.

backup.name: Back up pairings
backup.description: Saves a bridge's HomeKit identity (pairing keys, paired controllers, accessory IDs) and its options to a file in hap_bridge_backups/ in your config folder. Restore it into a re-added bridge and the Home app keeps every accessory, room and automation. The file holds private keys: keep it as safe as a password.

restore.name: Restore pairings
restore.description: Replaces a bridge's HomeKit identity and options with a backup's, then restarts it. Its current pairings are lost. Turn off the bridge the backup came from first, if it's still running: two bridges with one identity confuse the Home app.

file.name: Backup file
file.description: The file Back up pairings saved, e.g. hap_bridge_backups/hap_bridge_20261103_120000.json (or just its name).

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Shows what HomeKit would get for a device or entity: accessories, services, current values, which step built them, validation problems, and what's left out and why. Nothing is paired or changed.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Or a single entity to preview.

config_entry_id.name: Bridge
config_entry_id.description: Which bridge's options to use (default: the first).

no_bridge.message: No HAP Bridge is set up (or that bridge isn't loaded).

no_accessory.message: No bridge has an accessory with serial number {serial}.

no_pairing.message: No bridge has a controller paired with ID {pairing_id}.
